components.name: Primary button
components.description: The single decisive action per screen; brand teal pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid #0a5e5a; background: #0a5e5a; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #08443f; border-color: #08443f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a5e5a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Ink outline pill; hover tints teal mist.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid #242424; background: transparent; color: #242424; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0a5e5a; background: #d4e9e6; color: #08443f; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a5e5a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface, ash hairline, 12px radius, 40px padding.
components.html:
Plain language

We write findings anyone can follow.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #cecac8; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; padding: 40px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #242424; margin: 0; } .ds-card p { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; color: #4e4d4d; margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Eyebrow label
components.description: The one label style: teal uppercase marker above titles.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0a5e5a; }

components.name: Pill tag
components.description: Filter chip / status mark: parchment pill, ash hairline.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #cecac8; background: #f6f3f1; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.033em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #242424; }

components.name: Input field
components.description: Parchment field with ash border; focus turns border off-black.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #cecac8; background: #f6f3f1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #242424; font-size: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #625f5e; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #242424; outline: none; }

narrative.overview: Asmita's site reads like a carefully kept public record printed on warm paper: a parchment canvas, structure carried by 1px Ash hairlines and type, and exactly one decisive voice per screen — the brand teal fill of a single primary button. Nothing shouts; pastels exist only as blurred atmospheric washes. The result feels official without feeling governmental, warm without being soft about a hard subject.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment canvas, white cards, one teal-mist tinted band or elevated card per page
One primary action per screen; secondary actions are ink outlines
Teal uppercase eyebrow above every page title and section
Hindi resets tracking and gains taller line-height
Flat friendly illustration scenes, aria-hidden and decorative

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Brand teal fills at most one primary button per screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from 1px Ash hairlines and tonal steps, never from drop shadows.

rules.name: The Single Label Rule
rules.body: There is one label style — the teal uppercase eyebrow. Do not invent competing label styles.

dos: Do reuse AppShell, the eyebrow → page-title → lede hero pattern, .section-pad zones, .card, .data-table, Reading.tsx blocks, and existing Illustration scenes before inventing anything new.
Do keep exactly one .btn-primary per screen.
Do show honest empty states in a bordered surface-muted panel with one useful next action, as /research does.
Do verify 360px phone width: one column, no horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to cards, coloured left-border accent stripes on cards or callouts, or new accent colours.
Don't use pure white (#fff) as a page background or uppercase transforms in Hindi.
Don't redesign /start or any complaint-workflow screen.
Don't load a third-party icon set or illustration style.
